dataset_title: Site-level Dutch roadside-grassland standing-biomass productivity observations, 2023
derivation: Take the source Productivity value (g DM/m²) for each Dutch roadside site and convert to t DM/ha using 0.01 t DM/ha per g DM/m². This source field represents mean standing biomass from not-yet-mown plots in June and late August, not a collected yield.
license: CC BY 4.0 applies to source Zenodo version record; this is a GreenHub-derived descriptive extract
applicability: Site productivity context for Dutch roadside grasslands; not a mass-flow parameter or estimate of accessible, harvestable, collected, or contracted feed.
limitations: The data contain ten selected sites and are not a spatially representative Dutch supply inventory.
The productivity field averages standing biomass at two sampling periods; it must not be summed or interpreted as annual harvest yield.
The output is sensitive to site productivity and does not encode harvest height, regrowth, contamination, collection efficiency, or storage losses.
